title: Wonderful way to enjoy your meals on the go!
text: Wonderful way to enjoy your meals on the go!. Such a unique product! I typically bring lunch with me to work instead of buying it. Many times I have left overs (like yesterday I brought some meatloaf with me), but the sandwiches are cold by the time I get to eat them. Now with this little handy device I can plug in the bag about an hour before lunch and, presto, my lunch is warm and tasting fresh. I have already bought one for my son (who also brings his lunch/dinner with him on occasion) and will most likely give one as a gift this Christmas for a dear friend of mine up north. This is the kind of thing that would make a great gift for the person who has everything. Unique, classy and works!
